C-R6-PREFERENCE-CONTROLS-324.IntentSummary: Add explicit account controls and a single value-origin contract so adaptive suggestions remain subordinate to saved state, user intent and domain facts.

T-001.Title: kafedra-design: expose compact personal suggestion controls

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Desktop and mobile expose one Подсказки control with learning on/off, reset and safe pin/unpin actions in concise Russian text.
Controls do not expose work data, ACL or destructive choices and require no modal cascade.

T-002.Title: kafedra-motion: use no-motion for preference controls

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: No animation is introduced; visible focus and existing prefers-reduced-motion behavior remain sufficient.

T-003.Title: kafedra-feature: implement origin precedence and account-scoped controls

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Origin contract prevents suggested values from replacing saved, explicit or domain-derived values.
Existing preference table stores learning control and safe pins outside normal context ranking; reset deletes only learned rows for the current account.
Pinned values outrank frequency; disabled learning suppresses normal frequency read/write but leaves pins and domain-derived behavior active.
Plan/fact saved view and manual-plan async suggestions participate in the same origin contract.

T-004.Title: kafedra-design-audit: verify precedence and reset boundaries

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Saved view/manual input do not jump after late preference load; controls are clear on desktop/mobile and domain-derived values remain automatic.
Reset visibly affects suggestions only and does not imply deletion of plans, calendar, settings or evidence.

T-005.Title: kafedra-tests: prove account isolation pin precedence and delayed-response safety

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Tests cover two accounts, reset, pin-over-frequency, disabled learning, origin ordering, saved plan/fact view and a delayed suggestion after a trusted edit.
